services_included_copy: Foam Wash (20 mins): Gently lifts dirt and grime for a scratch-free, spotless exterior.
Tyre Cleaning (5 mins): Removes tough mud and brake dust for a deep-cleaned finish.
Tyre Polish (5 mins): Restores rich black shine with a clean, non-greasy look.
Exterior Wax (10 mins): Adds gloss and protection for a smooth, premium finish.
Glass Cleaning (5 mins): Crystal-clear, streak-free glass for better visibility and shine.
Vacuum Cleaning (10 mins): Deep cleans dust and debris from seats, floors, and corners.
Dashboard & Interior Wipe (10 mins): Removes dust and stains for a fresh, clean cabin.
Seat Cleaning (Leather/Leatherite) (5 mins): Cleans and refreshes seats based on material type.
Dashboard & Interior Polish (10 mins): Enhances interior with a smooth, premium matte finish.
Plastic Cladding Cleaning & Polish (20 mins): Revives faded trims to a fresh, like-new finish.
Deep Interior Detailing (10 mins): Removes stubborn dirt from trims, panels, and tight gaps for a detailed, like-new finish.
services_not_included: Interior Cleaning Limits: Seat dry-cleaning, deep stain removal, and inner roof cleaning are excluded.
Exterior Cleaning Limits: Bonnet (engine bay) and underbody cleaning are not included.
Special Cleanup Exclusions: Pet hair removal, biohazard cleanup (e.g., vomit/liquids), and surrounding floor water cleanup are not covered.
important_guidelines: Water Arrangement: Please make sure the car care expert can access a nearby water source before the service begins
Space Arrangement: Ensure enough open space around the vehicle for the cleaner to move and work comfortably.
Vehicle Movement: Cleaners will not start, drive, or move the vehicle. Please park it at the final service spot before cleaning begins.
Cancellation: Not allowed for booked Car Spa services.
Rescheduling: Allowed up to 3 times, as long as it's more than 2 hours before the slot start time.

data.question: What is included in the Car Spa package?
data.answer: Each wash includes exterior cleaning, interior vacuuming, tyre polish and dashboard cleaning.

data.question: Can I use this package for multiple cars?
data.answer: Yes, you can use package washes for your saved family cars where the service is available.

data.question: How long is the package valid?
data.answer: The package is valid for 6 months from the purchase date.

subscription_multipack.covers: Saved family cars where service is available

timing_slots.slot_length_observed: ~2 hours window (service duration itself is 40–90 mins depending on package)
timing_slots.reschedule_policy: Up to 3 reschedules; free if ≥2 hours before slot start; ₹100 fee if within 2 hours; cancellations not permitted

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Select your car type and package, review the inclusions, choose a time slot and address, and complete your payment.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
faqs.answer: You can reschedule your appointment up to 3 times. Rescheduling is free if requested at least 2 hours before your slot start time. Rescheduling within 2 hours of your slot will incur a ₹100 fee. Cancellations are not permitted, so please double-check your availability before making a payment.

faqs.question: Do I need to be present during the cleaning?
faqs.answer: We only require you to be there at the start and end, though we highly recommend staying to watch our detailed cleaning process! If you step away, remaining reachable by phone is highly recommended. Please park the car in its final spot, remove all valuables, and inspect the car before taking your keys back.

faqs.question: Will the professional bring all the equipment?
faqs.answer: Yes, they bring all tools and premium cleaning solutions. You only need to provide at least 2 buckets of water and adequate space around the car.

faqs.question: Are there any specific service limitations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cleaners will not start or drive your vehicle. Exclusions include: pet hair, deep fabric stains, biohazards, underbody, engine (bonnet), and inner roof cleaning.

faqs.question: Why choose the Full Car Spa Premium package?
faqs.answer: It goes beyond a basic wash by removing stubborn, sticky dust from the interior and restoring exterior plastic claddings to a dark, new-like finish. It also includes foam washing, waxing, and polishing for a protected, showroom fresh look.

faqs.question: Is your car wash service water-efficient?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Our advanced foam and premium cleaning agents lift dirt effortlessly, delivering a superior wash while using significantly less water than traditional local hose washes.
